description: Create a separate Omoro-designed style guide, palette/type sheet, or application brief for one style or a user-selected blend. Its visual system is grounded in each style's documented rendering techniques, palette, typography, and composition. This does not change blend_styles' established hero plus two supporting mockups.

brand_palette.description: Optional client-supplied colors, clearly kept separate from documented style palettes.

style_slugs.description: One to five Omoro style slugs in influence order. The first style leads the composition.

name: build_style_guide_output
